svg.title: ltpred pipeline: heritability, pedigree, CIP and family history join in estimate_liability
svg.desc: Before software: case definition and who the probands are. Population quantities: step 0 liability-scale heritability and optional covariances, step 2 CIP or lifetime prevalence; Lee conversion uses that same K. This sample: step 1 pedigree A, step 3 family-history status and age. Those become the family covariance Sigma = h squared times A, and the observation intervals D_F. Step 4 estimate_liability returns mu. Step 5 is a GWAS of mu, not an ltpred call.
